jobs.description:
The Finance Officer will handle key accounting and finance tasks, ensuring accurate financial records and compliance with regulations. 

Client Details

The company is located in Brussels.

Description

As a Finance Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage daily financial transactions and maintain accurate records.
• Prepare and review financial statements and reports.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
• Support month-end and year-end financial closing processes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to manage budgets and forecasts.
• Monitor accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in audits and implement recommendations as required.
• Provide financial analysis and insights to support decision-making.

A successful Finance Officer should have:

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.
• Residence in Brussels/Belgium.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Proficiency in financial software and tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
• Ability to communicate effectively in both English and French.

Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing organisation operating within a highly technical and project-driven production environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Assess the manufacturability and technical feasibility of customer-approved designs, identifying risks, constraints, and optimisation opportunities.
• Create and maintain production documentation including technical drawings, CAD models, work instructions, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ERP master data.
• Provide technical support to production teams, troubleshoot manufacturing issues, and contribute to root cause analyses and corrective actions.
• Optimise designs, materials, and production processes to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance manufacturing performance.
• Collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Product Management, and Engineering teams to ensure technical alignment and operational excellence.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Engineering, Design Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, technical design, or a similar production-focused role.
• Strong proficiency with CAD software (such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Inventor) and experience managing BOMs, routings, and technical master data in ERP systems (SAP, Dynamics, or similar).
• Solid understanding of manufacturing processes, design for manufacturability principles, technical problem solving, and cost estimation within an industrial environment.
• Analytical, detail-oriented, and hands-on professional with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
• Fluent in English and Dutch

Your main responsibilities:
 
 
 
• Organizing and coordinating shipments by road, rail, sea, and air 
 
• Operational monitoring of shipments (including sailings, railcars, and HSE) 
 
• Preparing and processing transport and shipping documents (including Bill of Lading, Letter of Instruction, Dispatch...) 
 
• Receiving and processing customs documents 
 
• Managing and updating transportation information and procedures (including in SharePoint) 
 
• Preparing and sending container and cargo manifests 
 
• Informing customers about costs, transit times, and shipment status

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum A2 diploma 

• Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience as a freight forwarder export or in a similar role 

• Strong operational knowledge of freight forwarding and logistics processes 

• Knowledge of transport documentation and IT systems 

• An IMDG certificate (dangerous goods) is a strong asset 

• Fluent in Dutch and English, both verbally and in writing 

• Meticulous, able to handle stress, customer-focused, and a strong communicator 

• Able to work independently and manage priorities

jobs.occupation: Budget Analyst at the U.S. Embassy in Belgium
jobs.description:
The U.S. Embassy in Brussels is looking for a Budget Analyst to join the Federal Aviation Administration.

Jobomschrijving

The job holder maintains budgets for all FAA lines of business in Brussels and FAA Representative offices located in Paris, Abu Dhabi, Dakar, Warsaw, and London. The budget management function includes expenditure forecasting, multi-year budget estimation, yearly travel budget development, expenditure tracking including travel burn rates, budget reconciliation, approval of payments, and submission of quarterly and close-out reports.

EDUCATION (multiple options): 2 years of University studies in any field or university degree in finance, accounting, business administration

EXPERIENCE: 2-5 years in finance, accounting, or business administration.

LANGUAGE: Fluency in English, French and Dutch.

Our client is a service-oriented industrial organization operating a high-volume production environment and currently undergoing a period of operational instability.

Jobomschrijving

• Stabilize day-to-day operations and re-establish operational control across the site.
• Identify root causes of process failures, bottlenecks, and inefficiencies, and implement corrective actions.
• Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance performance.
• Lead an operational turnaround focused on improving productivity, quality, and service levels.
• Rebuild trust, collaboration, and stability within operational teams through a visible, hands-on presence on the shop floor.

• Proven experience as an Interim Operations Manager, Plant Manager, or Crisis Manager in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
• Strong track record in operational turnarounds, crisis management, and performance recovery programs.
• Hands-on, pragmatic, and action-oriented professional who is comfortable working directly on the shop floor.
• Strong people management and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build trust and mobilize teams in challenging environments.
• Ability to quickly adapt to fast-paced operational settings with limited resources and deliver tangible results.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Senhive is a technology leader specialising in advanced counter-drone systems and autonomous sensor networks designed for high-security and mission-critical environments. Leveraging cutting-edge detection, tracking, and mitigation technologies, Senhive provides robust, real-time solutions in support of air traffic management systems and protects airspace from unauthorized or hostile drone activity. Serving defence, aerospace, security and critical infrastructure sectors, Senhive enhances situational awareness and operational security through intelligent, scalable, and resilient systems.
 

Job description
 

As Purchasing & Logistics Assistant, you will play a key role in keeping our purchasing and logistics operations running smoothly. You will ensure that the materials and components our teams need are ordered on time, that deliveries are properly received and processed, and that outgoing shipments are prepared accurately and efficiently.
 

Your responsibilities cover the entire operational flow, from placing purchase orders and coordinating with suppliers to checking incoming invoices and preparing shipments for customers and partners. When products are unavailable or delivery dates change, you take the initiative to find suitable alternatives and keep things moving.
 

In addition to the above, you will also contribute to the smooth day-to-day running of our office by taking care of a range of general and very practical facility and office management tasks.
 

This is a hands-on role combining practical warehouse and logistics activities with administrative & office-related responsibilities. We are therefore looking for someone who works proactively, takes ownership of their responsibilities and naturally spots what needs to be done. You enjoy bringing structure to day-to-day operations, solving practical problems and making sure things get done without having to be asked twice. 
 

More details in PDF file enclosed. 
 

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who is organised, proactive and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership and a practical approach to problem-solving.
 

You have:
 

• At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in purchasing, logistics, supply chain, warehouse administration or a comparable operational role. 
• Excellent knowledge of Dutch and English, both written and spoken). 
• Strong administrative skills and an eye for detail, particularly when handling orders, delivery documents and invoices. 
• The ability to organise your work independently, set priorities and follow up on outstanding tasks. 
• A proactive mindset: you identify what needs attention, anticipate potential issues and take action without waiting for instructions. 
• A solution-oriented attitude and the ability to find practical alternatives when things do not go according to plan. 
• The flexibility to switch between administrative tasks and hands-on operational work throughout the day. 
• Confidence in communicating with suppliers, couriers, colleagues and other external contacts. 
• A reliable and structured approach, with a strong focus on accuracy, follow-up and getting things done. 
• A willingness to take ownership of both the bigger picture and the smaller practical details that keep an organisation running smoothly.
 

You are comfortable working at a desk when the task requires it, but you are equally happy to receive deliveries, check goods and take care of practical logistics activities. You understand that a well-functioning operation depends on both accurate administration and effective execution.
 

Given the practical and on-site nature of this role, you live within maximum 30 minutes' driving distance of our workplace in Hasselt.
 

Experience with purchase order systems, ERP software, courier platforms and international shipping documentation is an advantage.

For an automotive company in Zeebrugge, we are looking for a full-time category B Driver for the 'YARD' department. You will work in a two-shift system.

What does the job entail?

As a Yard Driver / operator, you and your colleagues ensure that port terminal logistics run smoothly and without interruptions.

Main responsibilities:

• Shunting: Safely and efficiently maneuvering and moving vehicles from point A to point B across the yard / terminal grounds.
• Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI): Carrying out final quality checks before vehicles are dispatched to clients.
• Damage inspection: Checking incoming vehicles at the terminal for any existing damage.
• Periodic maintenance checks: Performing checks such as battery health checks and engine runs.

• driver's license: You have held a valid Category B driver's license for at least 2 years.
• language skills: Very good command (speaking and understanding) of either Dutch or English.
• work ethic: Reliable, punctual, and committed to working with precision and care.
• availability: Available full-time to work in a 2-shift rotation (06:30 - 14:15 / 14:30 - 22:15).

Compliance • Conformity • Governance • Operational Readiness • License to Operate
  
 
  
PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
  
Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of PMO-C²Trust Project Manager could be your next challenge.
  
 
  
About PMO-C²Trust: PMO-C²Trust is Kiwa Vinçotte's governance framework for complex industrial investment and engineering projects. Our mission is to help clients translate compliance, conformity and operational requirements into a structured, traceable and manageable project approach that supports a successful License to Operate. We connect project objectives, regulatory obligations, engineering activities, stakeholder responsibilities, conformity requirements and commissioning readiness into one integrated governance model. By creating visibility, accountability and evidence throughout the project lifecycle, we help clients reduce risk, avoid late surprises and achieve safe and compliant project delivery.
  
 
  
Your Mission: as a PMO-C²Trust Project Manager, you guide industrial projects from early project definition through engineering, construction, commissioning and operational release. You ensure that compliance, conformity, safety and permitting requirements are identified at an early stage, translated into practical project actions and managed through to successful completion. You act as a trusted governance partner for clients and create alignment between asset owners, engineering teams, suppliers, contractors, inspection bodies and certification organisations. Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.
  
 
  
Your Responsibilities:
  
 
  
Compliance & Conformity Management
    
• Identify and assess applicable European, national and regional legislation.  
• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects.  
• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables.  
• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities.  
• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.   
Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
    
• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes.  
• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers.  
• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths.  
• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.   
Operational Readiness & License to Operate
    
• Integrate conformity, safety, environmental and commissioning requirements into project execution.  
• Coordinate the collection and management of required evidence and project documentation.  
• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks.  
• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and ...

Education & Experience
    
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology or another relevant technical discipline.  
• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial, engineering, infrastructure, energy or manufacturing projects.  
• Proven experience in multidisciplinary project management.  
• Experience with industrial commissioning, conformity assessment, compliance management or operational readiness programmes is a strong asset.  
• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.   
Knowledge & Affinity
  
You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
    
• European product legislation and conformity assessment;  
• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles;  
• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF);  
• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness;  
• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements;  
• Occupational safety and statutory inspections;  
• Governance, stakeholder management and stage-gate methodologies.   
Knowledge of Belgian and Flemish environmental legislation, including VLAREM, is a strong asset.
  
Your strength lies in connecting expertise, asking the right questions and translating complex requirements into a coherent project approach.
  
 
  
Competencies
  
You:
    
• Translate complexity into structure and action.  
• Are comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior stakeholders.  
• Proactively identify risks, gaps and opportunities.  
• Combine ownership with strong organisational skills.  
• Balance regulatory rigour with practical project delivery.  
• Build trust through a professional, solution-oriented approach.   
Languages
    
• Dutch: Fluent  
• English: Professional proficiency  
• French: Strong asset   
You are willing to travel within Belgium and occasionally across Europe.

jobs.occupation: Lead Contract Engineer Nuclear Pressure Equipment (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As a Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X) in the Nuclear Pressure Equipment Team, you will join a dynamic team that works every day for our customers and, in doing so, helps create a safer and more efficient society. Vinçotte is active with various types of customers. We have developed our expertise and organization in both public and residential buildings, and we are highly entrepreneurial in the energy sector, including nuclear activities. In addition, we are highly innovative for customers in the (petro)chemical and pharmaceutical sectors, production environments, and the transport and logistics sector. With unparalleled expertise and boundless passion, we are committed to a safer society. With more than 60,000 satisfied customers, we demonstrate that the combination of our expertise, guidance, and technology makes all the difference. Vinçotte is part of Kiwa, which is itself a member of the SHV Family of Companies, and continues its commitment to innovation to deliver ever greater safety and efficiency.
 

As a 
Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X), you will be the point of contact for our customers. You build a relationship of trust with the customer and provide tailored advice for the assessment of the construction/design of nuclear pressure equipment according to various construction codes and standards. You maintain regular contact with your customers and also carry out inspections yourself. You are responsible for following up projects from A to Z, from quotation and design through to actual execution and invoicing. In addition, you are also the point of contact for the inspectors on site.
 

You can always rely on your colleagues: driven experts who are happy to help you further.
 

Vinçotte also supports you in deepening and broadening your expertise. We start this on your very first day, as you will first receive thorough training and an internship before working independently.

 

• Degree: You have a Master’s degree in Industrial Sciences – Electromechanics. A Welding Engineer degree is a strong asset. 

• Experience: You preferably have around five years of experience in the maintenance/inspection of pressure equipment. 

• Skills: 
 

• You are eager to learn and keep up to date with trends and developments in your field. 

• You have a sense of quality and an eye for detail. 

• You show initiative and enjoy customer contact. 

• You work independently and in a disciplined manner. 

• You speak fluent Dutch or French and have a good knowledge of English (both written and spoken). 

• You are communicative and entrepreneurial, with a sense of initiative and organization.
